scientific_question: How quickly does held-condition P4 performance recover as progressively more labelled P4 support measurements are supplied to one frozen-encoder cosine-prototype adapter?

source_lineage.preprocessing: 281 raw values -> 280 first differences -> frozen P1-P3-only population standardization

allowed_data: Frozen P1-P3-trained C1 checkpoints and P1-P3-fitted preprocessing state
P4 support features and labels selected by the frozen support manifest
P4 query features for frozen inference only
Prior frozen artifacts for lineage and non-comparable contextual references
forbidden_data_use: P4 query labels before every query prediction is frozen and SHA-256 registered
P4 query labels or metrics in support construction, tuning, method choice, representation choice, budget choice, stopping, or reruns
P4 query-derived preprocessing or transductive statistics
P4-labelled encoder fitting or checkpoint selection
Post-result method, threshold, seed, split, budget, or uncertainty changes

adaptation.definition: L2-normalize each support embedding; average within TagID; L2-normalize each class mean; predict the L2-normalized query embedding by maximum cosine similarity with lowest class index on an exact tie

label_budget.primary_x_axis_unit: total labelled raw P4 measurements across all TagIDs
label_budget.independent_information_unit: TagID x ER x surface x P4 physical condition block
label_budget.interpretation: Budgets through 42 can add condition blocks; budgets above 42 necessarily add repeated acquisitions from already represented blocks. Both counts are reported.

support_sampling.policy: For each fold and support seed, use one SHA-256-derived random permutation of the six eligible factor cells shared across TagIDs. Interleave TagIDs in a SHA-256-derived rotated round robin, drawing one row from every class-by-cell block before a second row from any block. Within each block use a deterministic random permutation of its 50 row ordinals. Every smaller budget is an exact prefix of every larger budget.
support_sampling.class_balance: Exact at 7, 21, and 35; otherwise per-TagID counts differ by at most one and the remainder rotates by fold and support seed.

support_query_protocol.query_label_rule: Global two-phase execution: generate and hash-register every budget/source/support/fold prediction first; only then open query-label seals once for final scoring.

metrics.primary: full-P4 out-of-fold sample Macro-F1, computed per source x support unit then equally averaged
metrics.zero_label_anchor: canonical frozen source head; equal mean across source seeds; must reproduce Accuracy 0.15663492063492063 and Macro-F1 0.11223088363457531 within 1e-15

uncertainty.block_resampling: sample nine physical blocks with replacement within each TagID, retaining all 50 rows in each sampled block
uncertainty.seed_resampling: resample five source-seed indices and twenty support-seed indices independently with replacement, then average their crossed paired units
uncertainty.pairing: common block/source/support draws for budget-vs-zero and adjacent-budget contrasts

primary_comparisons.versus_zero: Macro-F1(b) - Macro-F1(0) for every positive budget
primary_comparisons.incremental: paired adjacent-budget differences in ascending total-label order
primary_comparisons.multiple_testing_role: descriptive curve estimation; no family of null-hypothesis tests

predefined_thresholds.practical: first budget with point-estimate Macro-F1 improvement >= 0.05
predefined_thresholds.reliable: first budget whose paired 95% interval for Macro-F1 improvement has lower bound > 0
predefined_thresholds.key_meaningful_recovery: first budget satisfying both practical and reliable rules
predefined_thresholds.gap_fraction: not identifiable because neither retrospective 0.5835693346352661 nor matched within-condition 0.983494 is protocol-comparable
predefined_thresholds.diminishing_returns: report adjacent gain and gain per ten added labels without fitting or extrapolating a saturation model

classification_rule.coverage_dominant: CONDITION_COVERAGE_MORE_IMPORTANT_THAN_RAW_LABEL_COUNT only if the paired 7-to-35 improvement CI excludes zero, the 50-to-500 CI includes zero, and the point gain per label from 7 to 35 is more than twice that from 50 to 500
classification_rule.rapid: RAPID_TARGET_CALIBRATION_RECOVERY if the key meaningful recovery budget is <= 35 labels
classification_rule.gradual: GRADUAL_TARGET_CALIBRATION_RECOVERY if the key meaningful recovery budget is > 35 labels
classification_rule.weak: WEAK_OR_UNRELIABLE_TARGET_CALIBRATION_GAIN if no budget satisfies the key meaningful recovery rule

historical_connections.historical_few_shot: retain as external provenance values; rerun 7/21/35 matched anchors because the old episode/query and Euclidean protocol differ
historical_connections.retrospective: external non-held-out reference only; excluded from curve and gap fractions
historical_connections.matched_target_assisted: external within-condition dependence-inflated reference only; excluded from curve and gap fractions

stopping_and_amendment_rules: Stop before scoring on any checkpoint, preprocessing, P4 hash, split, budget, nesting, class-balance, exact-overlap, encoder-freeze, or query-label-boundary failure
Run a pre-label smoke test that generates and hashes predictions but never opens query labels
After the first valid full scoring pass, do not rerun, tune, replace seeds, alter budgets, or select another method
A genuine implementation defect requires an append-only incident record, minimal repair, new preregistration amendment hash, and preservation of the failed attempt
primary_endpoint: Macro-F1 calibration curve and paired improvement from the canonical strict-DG zero-label anchor
